units.source_text: 回到旅馆，她们把江湖画师和阿时的事全丢在脑后，只顾待在房间里，缝制冬天穿的棉袍。

en.t: When they returned to the inn, they put the traveling painter and O-Toki completely out of their minds, and simply stayed in their room sewing padded robes for winter.
It was the off-season, with no guests.

units.source_text: 她们捡来客人扔在客房里的许多旧杂志，却没有去阅读它们，一味漫无边际地遐想自己的故乡和婚事。

en.t: They gathered up many old magazines that guests had left behind in the rooms, but instead of reading them, they drifted endlessly into thoughts of their hometowns and marriages.

units.source_text: 从星期六到星期日，直到赏红叶的观光团来到之前，她们都没觉察到山里已经披上了秋色。

en.t: From Saturday through Sunday, until the sightseeing party came to view the autumn leaves, they did not notice that the mountains had already taken on their autumn colors.
